title: The Plum Stands In for the Peach
era: Warring States · King Wei of Qi

source.book: Records of the Grand Historian, Biographies of Sun Tzu and Wu Qi
source.quote: Now match your lowest team against his highest, your highest against his middle, and your middle against his lowest.

moral: Give away one round to win the whole match — a small loss can buy the bigger win.
